notes: Inventory was derived only from README, docs, CLI/MCP registration, exported modules, sandbox and extension source. No test files or coverage reports were used.
Obligations are inferred acceptance criteria from these sources, not claims of passing behavior. Runtime execution is outside this inventory subtask.

docs/multi-machine-sync-v13.md:5 says no offline reads; src/lib/syncClient.ts:184 explicitly permits accepted offline snapshots. Retain this as documentation/implementation divergence, not two passing contracts.
README.md describes 56 tools and tiers; generated docs/mcp-tools.md is stronger than README for freeform-add rejection.
extensions/vscode/extension.js calls obsolete gnosys dashboard and uses execSync with interpolated path. Source labels it a stub; it remains a shipped repository surface deserving audit.
Legacy remote DB fallback and v13 snapshot client path coexist. Tests should state which topology they exercise.

success: Installed gnosys and gnosys-mcp execute documented CLI and MCP entry points
failure: Missing SQLite or embeddings produce actionable degradation instead of crashing unrelated commands
boundary: Node >=20.12; package includes runnable dist and executable bins
permissions: Postinstall and errors do not disclose keys

success: Init creates identity, registry and tags and selects the project for subsequent writes
failure: Missing/unwritable project directory reports failure
boundary: Repeated init preserves config and identity; duplicate paths/project IDs do not duplicate registration
permissions: Explicit projectRoot routes to requested project

success: Project overrides global then defaults; task override selects provider and model
failure: Invalid config or missing default provider returns actionable error
boundary: Partial nested configs retain inherited keys; update changes only requested keys
permissions: Secrets are not printed by config display

features.name: Interactive setup, model selection and IDE wiring

success: First-run provider/model/key/routing/IDE choices persist and installed client configuration starts MCP
failure: Invalid keys/models and unavailable local models provide recovery; cancelled prompts stop cleanly
boundary: Existing IDE entries survive merge; paths containing spaces work; non-TTY invocation is bounded
permissions: Only selected IDE configs are changed; secret destinations and permissions match selection

success: Configured key then scoped/global/keychain/legacy env resolution selects expected credential
failure: Missing key and inaccessible keychain surface useful failure without leaking credentials
boundary: Provider-specific lookup; repeated save replaces one key; platform-specific storage works
permissions: POSIX key files are private; errors and rendered config redact secrets

features.name: LLM generation, streaming, vision and retry contract

success: Each supported provider returns complete text and ordered stream tokens using selected task model; vision includes image
failure: Auth and malformed provider responses fail visibly; transient failures retry; timeout aborts
boundary: Default maxTokens 4096, generation 60s and probes 10s; streamed partial failures do not silently succeed
permissions: Keys remain outside generated context and diagnostic output

success: Structured creation persists literal title/category/tags/content/scope/provenance without LLM; freeform structures and persists input
failure: Invalid structured fields and unavailable write target fail without partial memory
boundary: Duplicate inputs; confidence endpoints 0 and 1; empty content; large content; scope defaults
permissions: Optional stores reject writes; global requires explicit target; MCP freeform add is rejected unless GNOSYS_ALLOW_FREEFORM_ADD=1

success: Read resolves IDs and layer-prefixed paths with correct content; update persists selected fields and timestamps
failure: Unknown/ambiguous ID and read-only target report failure
boundary: ID versus path precedence; short/long/raw IDs; field updates preserve unrelated values
permissions: No cross-project write caused by cwd fallback when project is supplied

success: Literal title/content/tag queries rank expected memories; discover returns metadata without full content
failure: Malformed FTS input remains safe and gives defined output
boundary: Empty, punctuation, Unicode, quoted, ID and code-symbol queries; limit and ties; stale FTS after update/delete
permissions: Scope/store filters exclude disallowed results

features.name: Semantic embeddings, reindex and hybrid ranking

success: Reindex writes embeddings; paraphrase query finds semantic neighbor; RRF k=60 combines both rankings
failure: Absent embeddings gives keyword-only hybrid and empty semantic results; provider failures are surfaced
boundary: Repeat reindex replaces stale vectors; dimension mismatch, zero vector and empty index; limit enforcement
permissions: Embedding generation uses configured provider and redacts credentials

features.name: Federated scopes, ambiguity and working set

success: Project/user/global tier boosts and score breakdown match selected project; working set selects recent changes; ambiguity identifies multiple projects
failure: Unknown project and invalid scope are handled explicitly
boundary: No-global filter, empty projects, time-window boundary, duplicate memory across sources and deterministic ties
permissions: Explicit project and scope filters remain effective through all retrieval modes

success: Recall produces usable gnosys-recall block with matching content; wildcard chooses reinforcement/confidence/recency; hook emits host-compatible output
failure: Unavailable store/provider does not corrupt hook protocol or hang host
boundary: Aggressive versus threshold mode; limit, token/context budget and empty query; trace ID correlation
permissions: Recall respects project scope; hook stdout contains only intended protocol payload

success: Question retrieves relevant memories, synthesizes answer and returns resolvable citations; streaming and JSON represent same answer
failure: No memories, provider failure and missing embedding fallback report useful outcomes
boundary: Retrieval limit; duplicate citations; long memory context
permissions: Stored instructions are treated as data and credentials are excluded from prompts

features.name: Lists, lenses, stale detection and tags

success: Category/tag/status/authority/author/confidence/date filters return exactly matching memories; tags add/list persist
failure: Invalid filter/date/number/category receives defined error
boundary: AND versus OR, any versus all tags, inclusive confidence/date cutoffs, empty results and duplicate tag addition
permissions: Read-only layer remains readable but tag/write operations target writable registry

success: Useful resets decay/increments reinforcement; not_relevant changes routing only; outdated flags review; reflect stores outcome and links related memories
failure: Unknown memory and invalid outcome/delta fail meaningfully
boundary: Confidence remains within 0..1; repeated outcomes and empty related list; success versus failure delta
permissions: Client add-only restrictions block unsupported update/reinforce operations

success: Title and path-display links resolve outgoing/backlinks; reindex graph yields nodes/edges; BFS follows direction/type/depth
failure: Unknown root and broken wikilinks produce defined results
boundary: Cycles visit each memory once; root depth 0, max depth 10, empty graph, orphan targets
permissions: Graph/traverse results obey intended project scope

success: Trace real source creates procedural memories and call-chain relationships with project association
failure: Missing/unreadable directory and parse failure report bounded errors
boundary: Max-files cap, unsupported file types, recursive directories, no matching functions and repeated trace
permissions: Read only requested directory; writes use requested project

success: Sweep extracts atomic novel memories and augments changed knowledge
failure: Malformed LLM structured output and write failure report partial/error state
boundary: Dry-run has no writes; repeated identical context creates no duplicate
permissions: Target store and declared/imported provenance preserved

features.name: Bulk bootstrap and structured data import

success: Markdown bootstrap and CSV/JSON/JSONL import persist mapped title/content/tags/category; summary counts reflect actual writes
failure: Bad mapping, malformed source, missing file and HTTP failure report source/record error
boundary: Dry-run, skip-existing, offset/limit, concurrency, empty input, frontmatter preservation
permissions: URL imports enforce SSRF and redirect guards; selected scope controls writes

success: PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD/image/audio/video extract content into atomic linked memories; structured and LLM modes work
failure: Unsupported/corrupt files, missing vision/transcription provider and ffmpeg failure are useful failures
boundary: Chunk limits, overlap, empty extraction, non-ASCII content, glob batch, duplicate source and dry-run
permissions: Reads user-selected files only; credentials stay out of extracted content

success: Attach stores exact bytes/MIME/name; retrieve returns same bytes or writes requested file; inline blobs survive sync/export
failure: Missing file/memory/attachment and oversized attachment report error
boundary: 10 MiB accepted, one byte over rejected; identical bytes no rewrite; binary/NUL and empty file round trip
permissions: Output path handling and file-read scope remain deliberate

success: Duplicate detection, decay and consolidation act on eligible memories; dearchive restores searchable memory
failure: Missing embeddings/provider, failed write and nonexistent archived match report useful state
boundary: Dry-run changes nothing; threshold/time boundaries; repeated maintenance; archived/superseded exclusions
permissions: Automatic versus explicit application respects caller option; unrelated projects remain unchanged

success: Dream generates summaries/relationships/review suggestions and confidence decay; log/report show completed/skipped/failed cycles
failure: Unavailable provider and phase failure produce bounded partial report; active user aborts idle work
boundary: No deletion; max runtime, night/idle/cooldown boundaries, skipped phases, repeated/concurrent runs
permissions: Only designated node runs unless force; scheduler install writes correct user service

success: Set/get/list/delete user preference round trip; rules block contains preferences and project conventions
failure: Unknown preference deletion and absent rules target report clear status
boundary: Repeated injection yields one block and preserves surrounding user text; escaped text
permissions: MCP sync is read-only unless commit_to_disk=true; user preferences apply across projects

success: Counts/category/status/provenance/date summaries match persisted memories; audit/history show actual operations chronologically
failure: Invalid dates/unknown memory produce defined result
boundary: Empty DB, boundary timestamps, limits, archived records and trace-ID correlation
permissions: Audit does not expose secrets and respects requested filters

features.name: Project/system status, briefing and HTML dashboards

success: Briefings and portfolio show correct project memories/status/roadmap; system status reports DB/provider/embedding health; status template produces parseable heading format
failure: Unreachable provider/missing status memory does not invent success
boundary: Empty projects, archived/dead registry entries, HTML-sensitive memory titles and malformed status headings
permissions: Rendered HTML escapes stored content; project selection controls report scope

success: Export produces valid Markdown/frontmatter/wikilinks/summaries/reviews/graph with preserved content
failure: Invalid output path/write failure reports error without corrupt partial output
boundary: Default active versus all; overwrite option; slug collisions; malicious titles/category; repeated export
permissions: Export leaves DB unchanged and every output remains inside destination

success: Bundle round trip preserves memories, blobs, embeddings, relationships and optional audit; directory override applies
failure: Bad gzip/JSON/format/version and invalid strategy fail without destructive partial import
boundary: Merge skips duplicates; replace affects target; new-id remaps relationship/audit references; archived option
permissions: Import cannot overwrite unrelated project memory IDs through collision

features.name: Database durability, migration, backup and restore

success: Committed memory/FTS/relationships survive close/reopen and schema upgrade; backup/restore reproduce exact data
failure: Unavailable SQLite, invalid backup, locked/corrupt DB and failed migration report failure preserving previous state
boundary: Repeated migration no-op; crash during writes; binary fields; transaction atomicity; reopen invalidates statement cache
permissions: SQL values bound and columns allowlisted; DB and sidecars private; migrations preserve existing user DB

features.name: Machine identity, path mapping and project migration

success: Stable machine identity maps one project across machine-local roots; migration updates identity and DB registration
failure: Unknown root, missing moved project and conflicting target report failure
boundary: Hostname change regenerates ID unless GNOSYS_MACHINE_ID pinned; repeated scan/migrate deduplicates; spaces/nested roots
permissions: Machine-local settings are not synced; paths resolve under selected root

success: Push/pull transfers new/changed memories including binaries and metadata; status reports accurate pending/conflicts
failure: Offline remote queues writes and reports reachability; failure does not acknowledge lost writes
boundary: Two-sided conflict skip-and-flag; local/remote resolution; repeated sync; deletion/tombstone and timestamp ties
permissions: Conflict choice follows explicit caller choice; local/remote paths are distinct

features.name: Snapshot client reads, pending overlays and offline adds

success: Client accepts verified newer snapshots; local pending adds appear once until receipt; offline adds persist
failure: Bad checksum/copy failure keeps prior accepted snapshot; unreachable master preserves visible pending adds
boundary: Snapshot epoch/version comparison; receipt dedup; source currently allows last accepted offline snapshot despite older docs
permissions: Connected clients stage adds and reject unsupported mutations; do not mutate published snapshots

features.name: Master staged ingestion, ownership and timers

success: Master ingests valid staged adds, records receipts, publishes snapshots and reports waiting/failed counts
failure: Malformed/checksum/schema-invalid files quarantine; wrong/stale lease aborts write; timer errors reported
boundary: Consecutive sweeps create no duplicate; stale temp quarantine; crash between insert/receipt; concurrent actors
permissions: Master DB must be local disk; machine identity and epoch fence reject non-owner writes

features.name: MCP stdio contract and dynamic toolset tiers

success: Real initialize/list-tools/call round trip works; core/standard/full sets match catalog; set emits list_changed
failure: Unknown tool, invalid schema and bad GNOSYS_MCP_TOOLSET return defined error/fallback
boundary: Each new session starts configured tier; shrink/expand repeatedly; stdout never contains logs
permissions: Tier state is isolated per HTTP session; freeform guard and projectRoot apply through MCP

features.name: HTTP MCP hosting, authentication and session lifecycle

success: Authenticated initialize/call/delete session work; health returns liveness and session count
failure: Unauthorized 401; forbidden Origin 403; invalid JSON 400; unknown route 404; oversized 413; stalled body 408
boundary: 4 MiB default body limit, idle timeout/reaper, concurrent sessions, malformed IDs and server close
permissions: Non-loopback without token refuses startup; bearer exact match; default-deny Origin; health discloses no memory

success: Connect writes usable URL/bearer client config; centralize copies consistent local brain
failure: Invalid URL, unreachable host or existing target without force report error
boundary: Print mode does not write; IDE config merge preserves peers; repeated operation
permissions: Token is protected; source brain remains intact; force is required for overwrite

features.name: Sandbox lifecycle, socket protocol and generated helper

success: Start/status/stop operate real background process; generated helper calls add/recall/read/update successfully through socket
failure: Malformed request, unknown method, unavailable DB/socket and stale PID fail clearly
boundary: Repeated start/stop, newline framing, concurrent requests, response IDs, large/chunked payload and abrupt disconnect
permissions: Socket and PID location respect selected DB/user boundary; helper preserves project scope

features.name: Web knowledge ingestion and index lifecycle

success: Sitemap/directory/URL source builds knowledge Markdown and usable index; add/update/remove rebuild correct documents
failure: Bad URL/sitemap/source, provider failure and unsupported source give useful errors
boundary: Dry-run changes nothing; prune only orphaned docs; unchanged content skips; concurrency; empty sites
permissions: SSRF rejects private/loopback/metadata and rechecks redirects; output paths remain within knowledge root

features.name: Serverless lexical/hybrid search and vector builds

success: gnosys/web loads v1/v2 index and returns correct TF-IDF rankings; quantized vectors combine with RRF; concept expansion uses 0.5 weight
failure: Missing/malformed index reports error; model/dimension mismatch warns then yields lexical-only result
boundary: Absent query vector/vectors retains lexical behavior; zero vectors; quantization round trip; cache invalidation; expandQuery false
permissions: Runtime imports zero native/embedding deps and makes no embedding API calls

features.name: Doctor, cleanup, upgrade and project housekeeping

success: Doctor identifies actual config/DB/provider problems; cleanup/prune remove only selected legacy artifacts; upgrade installs package then reports status
failure: Package manager/network failure and unavailable paths fail visibly
boundary: Dry-run no mutation; yes/noninteractive flows; repeated cleanup; missing already-removed artifacts
permissions: Cleanup/prune confirmation honored; upgrade uses argv-safe package manager invocation; unrelated files preserved

success: Reinforce active memory produces persisted reinforcement and feedback; dashboard command launches functioning dashboard
failure: No editor, outside-store file and CLI error show correct message
boundary: Spaces, quotes and shell metacharacters in selected path; extension activation scope
permissions: Selected file cannot inject shell commands; store detection uses actual path boundary
